mostWorthwhile.text: Following the pancreas's insulin message to the muscle was most worthwhile: it connected a meal, a blood-carried message and glucose uptake.

leastWorthwhile.text: Setting up the falling-glucose view felt least worthwhile on its own; it mostly repeated the between-meal setup before the more informative pancreas response.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected the pancreas's release message to become fainter as glucose rose; that made the response feel less like a permanent switch.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though the later steps offered only one combination, so I was following the available route rather than figuring out compatibility.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter if it connected the systems in a new way. This comparison was clear, though the single-option stretches gave me few meaningful choices.
